d: Short, spiky platinum white hair with jagged bangs partially covering the face, paired with narrow, sharp eyes of a deep amber shade. Appearing as a mature youth with a lean, athletic build. The outfit consists of a tight-fitting black short-sleeved mock-neck shirt, black baggy trousers tucked into black high-top sneakers, and a long, flowing white sleeveless overcoat with a black lining, cinched at the waist by a white fabric wrap featuring turquoise ribbons and red accents. Signature details include a silver necklace with a pendant, black fingerless gloves, a small yellow cat plushie tucked into the waistband, and a katana with a red-wrapped hilt and ornate black scabbard.
